title: EP: Minicamp Is Over, Training Camp Is Next
channel_name: Love of the Star: A Dallas Cowboys Podcast
text: Zach and Bryan discuss any final thoughts on minicamp after it ended last week. The guys give an early preview of training camp. We also continue to praise DC Christian Parker and how he has already improved the defense after what we saw in minicamp. And we answer the best questions from our listeners on Twitter!
